        "Read all163 historical diff lines and both whole fixed browser test files. The owned patch clears thread selection before three rss.show.summary clearUserPref calls and before both onSelectPref assignments in website visibility setup/restoration.         "Manual style: about3Pane is a concrete shared test handle, getMessagePaneBrowser names the nested receiver, URI/readyState guards avoid waiting for an already delivered event, and short comments explain the clear-selection action. Distinct setup/action/assertion groups remain readable; future edits should inspect grouping separately from formatting. Native macOS menu-bar tasks are explicitly skipped; no platform, UI or a11y run.",
